faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any owner, manager, or employee of a pet shop, kennel, animal
               hospital, or shelter to fail to maintain the facilities in a sanitary condition, provide
               proper heating and ventilation, provide space appropriate to the size, weight, and
               species of animal, provide adequate nutrition, provide adequate veterinary care for
               all animals in their care, or to fail to take reasonable care to release for sale,
               trade, or adoption only those animals which are free of disease or injuries.
(Code 1981, § 6-76(e); Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
